text:
One end of a copper bar is heated to a high temperature.
Which mechanism is responsible for the transfer of thermal energy to the other end of the copper
bar?
A
the lattice vibrations of copper ions only
B
the lattice vibrations of copper ions and the movement of high energy electrons along the bar
C
the movement of high energy copper ions along the bar
D
the movement of high energy electrons along the bar only

options.label: A
options.text: the lattice vibrations of copper ions only

options.label: B
options.text: the lattice vibrations of copper ions and the movement of high energy electrons along the bar

options.label: C
options.text: the movement of high energy copper ions along the bar

options.label: D
options.text: the movement of high energy electrons along the bar only
